description: This file defines the Aldi class, a web scraper for Aldi recipes, inheriting from AbstractScraper. It includes methods to extract recipe details such as author, title, category, times, yields, image, ingredients, and instructions, utilizing HTML parsing and regex.

classes.name: Aldi
classes.description: A web scraper class for Aldi recipes, extending AbstractScraper, with methods to parse recipe details from HTML content.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for Aldi's website.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the site, 'Aldi'.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author meta content from the HTML.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from the HTML.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Extracts the recipe category from a specific link element.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Calculates preparation time using regex matching.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Calculates cooking time using regex matching.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Sums prep and cook times to get total time.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and processes the yields or servings information.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe image URL from a figure element.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Collects list of ingredients from the HTML.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Joins and returns the recipe instructions from list items.

methods.name: _get_value
methods.description: Helper method to extract label values from HTML, using regex or string matching.
